issues.description: Wrong page rendered: The current screen (step-3b) is supposed to show Style Blend Confirmation with percentage bars (e.g., 65% Scandinavian, 35% Japandi), a confirm button, and slider adjustment options. Instead, the Step 1 room selection UI is being displayed.
issues.root_cause: Console logs show page:mount events firing for both step-3b AND step-2 simultaneously at the same timestamp (ts:1776404435017 and ts:1776404435199). This indicates a routing/redirect issue: step-3b is mounting but then immediately redirecting back to step-2, which then falls back to rendering step-1 UI due to state loss. The URL shown is /design/step-2 but the page content appears to be step-1, suggesting the state management (likely Zustand or Context) is being reset on navigation, causing the wizard to restart at step-1.

issues.description: Hydration mismatch on percentage bar width: Console warning shows Prop `style` did not match. Server: 'width:5%' Client: 'width:15%'. This indicates the style percentage values are being computed differently on server vs client, causing SSR/CSR mismatch on step-3 percentage bars.
issues.element: Style percentage bar div in step-3/page.tsx
issues.root_cause: In app/design/step-3/page.tsx around line 59, a div has style={{width: `${percentage}%`}} where the percentage value is derived from state or random computation that differs between server render and client hydration. The server computes 5% and client computes 15%, indicating the percentage is read from non-deterministic or client-only state (localStorage, sessionStorage, or Math.random()) during SSR.

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' errors appearing 7 times, and 'entire root will switch to client rendering'. This causes full SSR breakdown.
issues.element: Multiple text nodes across step-3 and step-3b pages
issues.root_cause: Style names or percentage values rendered as text content differ between server and client renders, likely because style data is sourced from client-side storage (localStorage/sessionStorage/cookies) or non-seeded random functions that produce different results on server vs client.

issues.description: Step-3b page immediately redirects/falls back to step-2 then step-1: The page:mount events show step-3b mounting at ts:1776404435017 and step-2 mounting at ts:1776404435199 — only 182ms later. This means step-3b has a guard/redirect that is sending users back.
issues.root_cause: step-3b likely has a useEffect or top-level redirect that checks if prior steps are complete (step-1 room selection, step-2 quiz answers, step-3 style detection). Due to hydration failure wiping client state, these checks fail and redirect the user backward through the wizard.

issues.description: Style keys showing as COVA* internal keys instead of human-readable names (potential — cannot visually confirm since wrong page rendered, but noted in expected behavior spec as a known risk).
issues.element: Style name labels on step-3b percentage bars
issues.root_cause: If a styleKeyToLabel mapping or i18n lookup is missing or incorrectly keyed, raw keys like COVA_SCANDI or COVA_JAPANDI would render instead of 'Scandinavian' or 'Japandi'.

fixes.reason: Suppresses the SSR/CSR hydration mismatch warning for the dynamic percentage width while the root cause (non-deterministic state) is fixed. This is a temporary mitigation.
Prevents server-side rendering of dynamic percentage values that differ from client state, avoiding hydration mismatch. Renders 0 on server, actual value on client after hydration.
Delays the route guard check until after client-side hydration is complete, preventing premature redirects caused by state being unavailable during SSR/initial render.

Wraps the Zustand store with persist middleware so that wizard state (room selection, quiz answers, style scores) survives page navigation and is available when step-3b mounts, preventing the redirect loop back to step-1.
Completes the persist middleware configuration using sessionStorage so state persists across route changes within the same browser session but clears when the session ends.
